BatchQueryRequest.description:
Batch query request: multiple auto-commit DML statements executed inside a
single shared auto-commit batch window.

BatchQueryResponse.description: Batch query response: one [`QueryResponse`] per input statement, in order.

ClearFulltextIndexRequest.description:
Clear a fulltext index request.

Explicit destructive operation: drops all indexed documents without
backfill. Requires `force = true`.

force.description: Explicit confirmation of the destructive clear

ClearVectorIndexRequest.description:
Clear a vector index request.

Explicit destructive operation: drops all indexed points without
backfill. Requires `force = true`.

force.description: Explicit confirmation of the destructive clear

generation.description: Outbox generation used by this rebuild attempt, if known

consistency.description: Consistency level: None = eventual (default), Some("read_your_writes") enables RYW.

parameters.description: Query parameters bound to `@name` references in the statement.

session_variables.description:
Session variables bound to `$name` references in the statement.
When omitted, the session-managed snapshot (set via `LET $name = expr`)
is used.

RebuildFulltextIndexRequest.description:
Rebuild a fulltext index request.

The rebuild runs asynchronously: the handler returns a rebuild id
immediately and the caller polls the rebuild status endpoint.

RebuildFulltextIndexResponse.description: Rebuild a fulltext index response (accepted async task).

rebuild_id.description: Async rebuild task id for status polling

RebuildVectorIndexRequest.description:
Rebuild a vector index request.

The rebuild runs asynchronously: the handler returns a rebuild id
immediately and the caller polls the rebuild status endpoint.

RebuildVectorIndexResponse.description: Rebuild a vector index response (accepted async task).

rebuild_id.description: Async rebuild task id for status polling

VectorFilter.description: Top-level payload filter with Qdrant-style clause groups.

generation.description: Outbox generation used by this rebuild attempt, if known

vectors_scanned.description: Vertex snapshots scanned from primary storage

consistency_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds when consistency is read_your_writes

minimum_lsn.description: Minimum LSN to wait for (when RYW)

tag.description: Single label tag name (single-label vertices carry exactly one tag)
